name: Samurai Elf
source:
An elf native to the Yamatai Region, she follows the bushido code. Originating in Yamatai Village, the bushido code had a profound influence on the nearby elven village. However, the bushido code has long been a thing of the past in Yamatai Village, and only lives on in the elven village.

The Samurai Elf is on a mission to preserve the peace and order in the area, removing outsiders by force. Since she is both an elf and a trained warrior, a human warrior would struggle to match her in combat.

When her opponent is a man, she prefers using pin techniques. After defeating him, she will rape him. Despite the bushido code, this act is triggered by her monster instincts.

She gets along well with the Kunoichi Elf, and pairs of them are frequently seen patrolling the area.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
